from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single paper from the provided collection, identifying itself and what it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper")
    cites_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers (from the collection) that this paper references in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
